context.control_limits_en: 1551–1911: No OHM admin_level=2 relation found and no sourced southern limit; Sanusi influence in the interior not a border. | 1911–1934: Italian invasion 1911; Treaty of Ouchy 1912; interior contested in Italo-Sanusi wars to 1931/32. No OHM shape for 1912–1934. | 1934–1951: 1934 Italo-British-Egyptian agreement moved the Sarra Triangle (>30,000 sq mi) from Anglo-Egyptian Sudan to Libya; Libya–Sudan line = 25°E, 20°N, 24°E. | 1951–2026: Independence recommended by UNGA 289 (IV) A for not later than 1 Jan 1952; achieved 24 Dec 1951 [VERIFY – date not in the resolution] (OHM 2801143). Aouzou claim 1973–94 ended by ICJ.
